'''Jon Westergard''' was a Day 2 qualifier at the [[2003 Mystic Visions|2003 Mystic Visions Open]]. He played the [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]]. He finished 6th of 15 at the New York City Open Qualifier at Neutral Ground on 8 January 2005.<ref name="pcf-4273-59872">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59872#59872 January 8th 2005.  Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58673%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
